answer: The proof press stands beside the big press, and the small press shows what the big one will do. Paper rag electrotyper signature seal is the showing: a seal rag electrotypers renew after electrotype room hearings. The knoll is the first proof, pulled at the small press; the ripple is the last, pulled before the forme is locked, and the saffron is the press itself, small and true. A cheat must pull 31 false proofs and lock 31 false formes.
